pieces.name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
pieces.description: Moves like a queen: slides any distance in any direction. Royal: you lose when all of your royal pieces are captured (you start with three).

customArt.description: Like tung tung tung sahur, in other words like a long wood circle with a wooden bat.

pieces.name: Tralalero Tralala
pieces.description: Slides any distance in any direction.

customArt.description: A three-limbed shark wearing blue Nike Air sneakers.

pieces.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo
pieces.description: Slides any distance in a straight line. BOMB DROP: instead of moving, it stays where it is and destroys every piece on the 8 squares around it (3x3 grid), friend or enemy, royal pieces included. It is never harmed by its own bombs. Needs at least one piece next to it, then 3 turns to recharge (the badge counts down).

customArt.description: A dangerous hybrid of a crocodile and a military bomber plane
A coffee-cup dancer in a pink tutu.

pieces.name: Hydrogen Bomb
pieces.description: Never moves on its own (only a Catapult can move it). DETONATE: on your turn, instead of moving anything else, it destroys every piece in the 5x5 grid around it, friend or enemy, royal pieces included, and itself too. If a Catapult flings it, it detonates where it lands.

pieces.name: Cappuccino Assassino
pieces.description: Moves 1 forward (2 on its first move) and captures diagonally forward. Becomes a Tralalero Tralala on the far rank.

customArt.description: A coffee-cup assassin with sharp knife limbs.

pieces.name: Coughing Baby
pieces.description: Does nothing. Cannot move and cannot capture anything by itself. It can still be captured, and a Catapult can fling it (and it crushes whatever it lands on, like any flung piece).

pieces.name: Catapult
pieces.description: Slides any distance in a straight line, like a rook. FLING: instead of moving, it launches any piece (either side) on one of the 8 squares around it. The piece flies straight away from the catapult, over anything in between, and lands 1 to 4 squares further on. It can land on an empty square or crush one of the Catapult's enemies there, kings included, but never on a friend of the Catapult. If the crushed piece survives, the flung piece stays where it was. A flung Hydrogen Bomb detonates where it lands.
